ms.report:
MR: The team has submitted evidence for some of the milestone deliverables, but not all. The team was supposed to post translations of Cardano related content on their website in three different languages - while the content in English is present none of the translations are available at this time (please clarify what does "As about" mean in the spreadsheet). 
Response: Kindly check for the update. https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1MK2hN_IimPGDcb46NGPUNcA2h2BqhZqFjEhDS4FaQWc/edit#gid=0 

MR: While it indeed seems that the ETH main event was held on October 7 and 21, the recording of the main room from the 7th is the only one posted to their YouTube channel. 
MR: As for breakout rooms, for the 7th only the Vietnamese and Japanese room recordings are posted and for the 21st only the Japanese breakout room is posted.
Response: Click on the relevant Docs link (i12) for a detailed explanation. 

MR: The team also had as a deliverable for this milestone 10 different surveys, however, evidence of only one has been submitted.
Response: That would be mistaken and typos: There are three surveys for each round and for 3 countries (Indo/JP/VN). Round 1, milestone 1 and the second round would occur in the final millstone, and 6 surveys/times (Indo/JP/VN) would be presented if all communities still collaborate with Eastern Town Hall by April 2024.

﻿MR: For the "Execute action plan" deliverable, only a link to the original proposal has been submitted - please explain.
Response: The reason that we pointed to the original proposal and mentioned in cells H23-H25, as written, “More info, please click here and --> 3rd IMPACT, Thank you.” For an explanation of “execute the action plan” as listed in the 3rd Impact of the proposal, in case need more clarification.
